# The Points Guy

> The Points Guy helps travelers maximize rewards through expert guides on credit cards, airline miles, hotel points, and travel deals.

The Points Guy is a comprehensive travel rewards platform offering reviews, guides, and news on credit cards, loyalty programs, and travel optimization. The site covers major card issuers like Chase, American Express, and Capital One, as well as hotel chains and airlines including Marriott, Hyatt, and American Airlines.

## Key Topics

- Travel rewards
- Credit card reviews
- Points and miles
- Loyalty programs
- Airline deals
- Hotel reviews
- TSA PreCheck
- Global Entry
- Clear+
- Chase Freedom Unlimited
- American Express
- Marriott Bonvoy
- Award bookings
- Card comparison
- Travel guides

## Core Hubs

- [Homepage](https://thepointsguy.com): Homepage for The Points Guy travel rewards and guides site
- [Reviews](https://thepointsguy.com/reviews): Review hub for credit cards, hotels, and flights with comparisons
- [Travel Guides](https://thepointsguy.com/guides): Travel guides covering rewards, deals, tips, and airport access
- [Travel Deals](https://thepointsguy.com/deals): Hub for travel deals covering flights, hotels, and award bookings
- [News](https://thepointsguy.com/news): News hub for credit cards, travel, hotels, and aviation updates
- [All Content](https://thepointsguy.com/all): All-content archive page for travel rewards and guides
